findings.title: Consume recovery codes in the federation test provider and test reuse
findings.body: The new recovery-code validator accepts any matching code without removing it or recording that it was used. In addition, getCredentials() reconstructs the credential from the unchanged original list on every call, so the login form always requests the first code and the authenticator never observes an exhausted credential. The new integration test therefore passes even though the same recovery code can authenticate indefinitely and regeneration after exhaustion is never exercised. Update the test provider to persist consumption, and extend the test to verify that a used code is rejected, the requested code advances, and exhausting the codes triggers configuration of a new set.
